summary: Executed backend+frontend regression on preview URL. Backend contracts passed 8/8 with expected AR totals. DebtFollowUp behavior is inconsistent: first UI run rendered zero/empty, second run rendered expected 12570 and 12 customers from the same environment.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent rendering: one run showed empty/0 state, another run showed correct totals (12570, 12 rows) without code changes.

integration_issues.issue: API probes from browser context returned 200 and correct payloads (/finance/ar/customers total_ar=12570, /customers positive total=12570, count=12), but first UI run still rendered empty/0.

action_items: Stabilize DebtFollowUp hydration to avoid false empty state when requests are slow/aborted during route transitions.
Add guarded state merge/logging around fetchData + hydrateCurrentAr race to ensure AR rows persist when /finance/ar/customers succeeds.
Keep AR rows as authoritative source and prevent fallback flows from overwriting non-empty AR entries with empty payloads.
critical_code_review_comments: DebtFollowUp now uses direct /api/finance/ar/customers call first and sets entries before customers/suppliers/chart-of-accounts fallbacks (non-blocking pattern present).
VehicleDetails resolveItemBillingType keeps itemType=part as workshop; supplier only when billingType/itemType explicitly supplier.
Vehicle file supplier labels are aligned: 'حركة الموردين' and 'أرشيف موردين' shown in VehicleFinancialSummary/VehicleDetails source views.
routes_finance.py ar_customers endpoint returns build_current_visit_ar_snapshot result directly (read-side); no write/mutation path executed in tested AR flows.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (login+page load stable; DebtFollowUp data render flaky)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No DB mutation/restore/migration executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use same preview URL and credentials. Re-run /debts-followup at least twice after login; one run may show empty/0 while another shows expected 12570 and 12 rows. Backend remains stable: iter313 pytest 8/8 passed.
rca of the issue: Likely frontend race/intermittency in DebtFollowUp between fetchData(), hydrateCurrentAr(), and concurrent background requests under aborted network calls during route lifecycle. Backend responses are correct and reproducible; inconsistency appears in UI state hydration timing/overwrite.
